# Credentials by Role

> Which certifications the evidence lists for each role, at which tier, and each credential's status, as of 2026-11-19.

## How to read this page

- **Credentials are tie-breakers, not skills.** Their signal depends on the hiring channel [B/C · T0-11, T0-31, T0-34]. Decide whether to sit one with the [credential ROI guide](credential-roi.md) and compare all 194 evaluated credentials in the [credential catalog](credential-catalog.md) before using this role map.
- **Tiers:** *Important* means the evidence treats it as a differentiator for the role; *Optional* means it helps only where the channel or the posting rewards it; *Avoid* means retired, so new candidates should not pursue it (holders may still list it with its date).
- **Statuses** are class V2 facts, as of the dates shown; re-verify by 2027-02-17.

## At a glance

- 23 of 29 roles list at least one credential; 6 list none, so proof of work decides.
- Across 58 role-mapped credentials: 3 retired, 4 in beta, and 2 announced/booking-ambiguous (verify live portal before scheduling).

## Roles with no credential in the evidence

For these roles the research names no credential that changes hiring outcomes; publications, merged contributions, shipped systems or case studies carry the signal instead:

[Research Engineer / Member of Technical Staff](../02-roles/hubs/research-engineer.md), [Research Scientist (LLM research)](../02-roles/hubs/research-scientist.md), [Frontier AI Safety / Alignment Researcher](../02-roles/hubs/ai-safety-researcher.md), [Domain Evaluation Specialist / AI Trainer](../02-roles/hubs/domain-evaluation-specialist.md), [AI Engineering Manager / Director](../02-roles/hubs/ai-engineering-manager.md), [VP / Head of AI](../02-roles/hubs/vp-head-of-ai.md).

## Evidence and limits

- Tiers and notes come from the role inventories in [data/skills_ontology.json](../../data/skills_ontology.json), which cite Phase 0 ([T0-11](../../research/sessions/T0-11-certification-cloud-credential-roi.md), [T0-15](../../research/sessions/T0-15-regulatory-ai-governance-career-families.md)), Phase 3 ([T3-01](../../research/sessions/T3-01-genai-certification-stack-ranking-sequencing.md), [T3-02](../../research/sessions/T3-02-genai-certification-stack-ranking-sequencing.md)) and RP2 certification and role dossiers ([T0-29](../../research/sessions/T0-29-certifications-frontier-labs-ai-native-vendors.md), [T0-31](../../research/sessions/T0-31-certifications-data-enterprise-ai-platforms.md), [T0-32](../../research/sessions/T0-32-certifications-gpu-infrastructure-open-source.md), [T0-34](../../research/sessions/T0-34-certifications-governance-security-privacy-audit.md)). Hyperscaler cloud exams (T0-28) and vendor learning paths (T0-33) are deferred past 2026-12-05.
- For the full 194-credential scored database (fees, proctoring, channel weights and pass/skip verdicts), see the [credential catalog](credential-catalog.md).
- Credentials without a status are not assessed in the research corpus; their tiers are practice-curated (Grade D).
- No session measures a credential's effect on pay or offers. The evidence is about screening signal by channel.
